narr: Tropical Storm Ophelia tracked northward across east central North Carolina and up through central Virginia from Saturday morning, September 23rd into early Sunday morning, September 24th. Bands of heavy rain associated with the storm caused flash flooding across portions of central and south central Virginia.
ev: High water was reported on several roads in various parts of the county.
High water was reported on Boydton Plank Road in Dinwiddie county.
High water was reported at the intersection of Belvidere Street and Canal Street per VDOT cameras.
Storys Station Road (Route 611) was closed due to flash flooding.
High water was reported at the intersection of Route 10 and Route 1 in Chester. This was confirmed by VDOT camera and social media.
High water was reported at the intersection of Walmsley Boulevard and Broad Rock Boulevard via VDOT cameras.
